cond_0057.intro: We are looking for an Automation Engineer who will lead our automation core team within the Protein and Bioanalytical Sciences group. This person will be central to developing solutions that increase the efficiency, throughput, and cost effectiveness of processes conducted by the ADC Discovery and Cancer Immunology department, in support of the [Company name masked] Oncology research community. The Automation Engineer will collaborate with subject matter experts in ADC Conjugation and Protein Bioanalytical Sciences to analyze existing processes and tools with the goal of identifying high impact, automation focused improvements. The Automation Engineer will collaborate with scientists to execute and, at times, drive projects that fulfill the department's objectives. The goal is to enhance the research community's ability to quickly find targeted therapies to enable rapid advancement of cancer therapeutics.

cond_0065.intro: We are looking for an Automation Engineer who will lead our automation core team within the Protein and Bioanalytical Sciences group. This person will be central to the development of solutions that increase the efficiency, throughput and cost effectiveness of processes conducted by the ADC Discovery and Cancer Immunology department, in support of the [Company name masked] Oncology research community. The Automation Engineer will collaborate with subject matter experts in ADC Conjugation and Protein Bioanalytical Sciences to analyze existing processes and tools with the goal of identifying high impact, automation focused improvements. The resulting data driven recommendations will ensure that the proposed solutions have a meaningful positive effect on Key Productivity Indicators. The Automation Engineer will collaborate with scientists to execute and, at times, drive projects that fulfill the department's objectives. The goal is to enhance the research community's ability to quickly find targeted therapies to enable rapid advancement of cancer therapeutics.
cond_0065.responsibilities: Lead development of automated protocols on a variety of laboratory instruments. Take calculated risks and design automated solutions that are robust and easy to operate but provide [Company name masked] with a competitive edge. Keep your finger on the pulse of technology advances that can be leveraged to increase performance and robustness of [Company name masked]'s laboratories. cond_0253.intro: We are looking for an Automation Engineer who will lead our automation core team within the Protein and Bioanalytical Sciences group. This person will be central to developing solutions that increase the efficiency, throughput, and cost effectiveness of processes conducted by the ADC Discovery and Cancer Immunology department, in support of the [Company name masked] Oncology research community. The Automation Engineer will collaborate with subject matter experts in ADC Conjugation and Protein Bioanalytical Sciences to analyze existing processes and tools with the goal of identifying high impact, automation focused improvements. These may include process, instrument, and software improvements. The resulting data driven recommendations will ensure that the proposed solutions have a meaningful positive effect on Key Productivity Indicators. The Automation Engineer will collaborate with scientists to execute and, at times, drive projects that fulfill the department's objectives. The goal is to enhance the research community's ability to quickly find targeted therapies to enable rapid advancement of cancer therapeutics.

cond_0261.intro: We are looking for an Automation Engineer to join our team. This person will work alongside our automation core team within the Protein and Bioanalytical Sciences group, collaborating with subject matter experts in ADC Conjugation and Protein Bioanalytical Sciences to analyze existing processes and tools and identify high-impact automation improvements. These may include process, instrument, and software improvements. Together, the team will use data-driven recommendations to ensure proposed solutions have a meaningful positive effect on Key Productivity Indicators. The goal is to support the research community's ability to quickly find targeted therapies and enable rapid advancement of cancer therapeutics.
cond_0261.responsibilities:
Coordinate with the team on development of automated protocols on a variety of laboratory instruments, including liquid handlers such as [Product name masked] and [Product name masked].
Support automation efforts within the functional team; work with colleagues to advise, plan, and forecast how new automation strategies can enhance throughput and efficiency, then help build the solutions.
Contribute to designing automated solutions that are robust and easy to operate but provide [Company name masked] with a competitive edge.
Share knowledge of programming languages like C+ and Python to enhance or expand the capabilities and flexibility of automated laboratory solutions.
Help keep the team informed of technology advances that can be leveraged to increase performance and robustness of the laboratories.
Work cross-functionally with scientific subject matter experts, contributing to shared decision-making to reach the best solutions.
Collaborate on development of robust experiments that evaluate feasibility of potential automated solutions, using data to guide direction.
Work alongside scientists to learn or enhance laboratory skills related to ADC bioconjugation and protein purification to help deliver highly characterized molecules for discovery research.
Execute and document early-stage experiments, feasibility studies, and validation studies together with the team.
Coordinate on ideas, shared responsibilities, and timelines to meet milestones and deliver results.
Support colleagues with laboratory automation challenges and troubleshooting.
Share regular updates with group leaders to keep them informed of progress.

The Automation Engineer will coordinate with subject matter experts in ADC Conjugation and Protein Bioanalytical Sciences to analyze existing processes and tools, identifying high-impact, automation-focused improvements across process, instrument, and software areas. Data-driven recommendations will be used to ensure proposed solutions have a meaningful positive effect on Key Productivity Indicators. The goal is to support the research community's ability to find targeted therapies and advance cancer therapeutics.
cond_0439.responsibilities:
Lead development of automated protocols on a variety of laboratory instruments.
Develop assays on liquid handlers, such as [Product name masked] and [Product name masked].
Oversee automation efforts within the functional team; advise, plan, and forecast how new automation strategies can enhance throughput and efficiency, then help build the solutions.
Take calculated risks and design automated solutions that are robust and easy to operate while providing [Company name masked] with a competitive edge.
Apply knowledge of programming languages like C+ and Python to enhance or expand the capabilities and flexibility of automated laboratory solutions.
Monitor technology advances that can be applied to increase performance and robustness of [Company name masked]'s laboratories.
Coordinate with scientific subject matter experts on specific technical decisions to reach the best solutions.
Contribute to the development of robust experiments that evaluate feasibility of potential automated solutions, using data to guide direction.
Work alongside scientists to learn or build on laboratory skills related to ADC bioconjugation and protein purification, supporting delivery of characterized molecules for discovery research.
Execute and document early-stage experiments, feasibility studies, and validation studies.
Propose ideas, own responsibilities, and manage timelines effectively to meet milestones and deliver results.
Apply strong problem-solving skills to support laboratory automation tasks.
Report progress to group leaders to keep them informed.
cond_0439.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's Degree in Biochemistry, Engineering, or related field with 9+ years of experience, or Master's Degree with 7+ years of experience in a laboratory setting, including 3+ years developing laboratory automation of varying complexity.
Ability to program liquid handling robotics with strong knowledge of liquid class optimization.
Experience using programming languages to enhance the processing capabilities of automated platforms.
Ability to lead projects independently, with an understanding of when to seek guidance.
Strong troubleshooting and automation methodology capabilities.
Experience generating metrics and acting based on data.
Strong written communication and clear, direct verbal reporting skills.
Experience writing plans, protocols, and reports for equipment qualification, experimental design, feasibility studies, and validation.
Preferred Requirements
Prior experience with [Product name masked] liquid handlers, including end-to-end coding of new methods.
Experience performing bioconjugation and/or protein purification in an industry setting.
Experience with process mapping and Gantt charting.
Experience building customized parts for improved automation.
Experience with ELN integration.
Willingness to assist colleagues with automation-related issues as needed.

cond_0505.intro: We are looking for an Automation Engineer who will lead our automation core team within the Protein and Bioanalytical Sciences group. This person will be central to developing solutions that increase the efficiency, throughput, and cost effectiveness of processes conducted by the ADC Discovery and Cancer Immunology department, in support of the [Company name masked] Oncology research community. The Automation Engineer will collaborate with subject matter experts in ADC Conjugation and Protein Bioanalytical Sciences to analyze existing processes and tools with the goal of identifying high impact, automation focused improvements. These may include process, instrument, and software improvements. The resulting data driven recommendations will ensure that the proposed solutions have a meaningful positive effect on Key Productivity Indicators. The Automation Engineer will collaborate with scientists to execute and, at times, drive projects that fulfill the department's objectives. The goal is to enhance the research community's ability to quickly find targeted therapies to enable rapid advancement of cancer therapeutics.
cond_0505.responsibilities: Lead development of automated protocols on a variety of laboratory instruments. Development of assays on liquid handlers, such as [Product name masked], and [Product name masked]. Oversee automation efforts within the functional team; advise, plan and forecast how new automation strategies can enhance throughput and efficiency. Then help build the solutions. Take calculated risks and design automated solutions that are robust and easy to operate but provide [Company name masked] with a competitive edge. Leverage knowledge of programming languages like C+ and Python to enhance or expand the capabilities and flexibility of automated laboratory solutions. Keep your finger on the pulse of technology advances that can be leveraged to increase performance and robustness of [Company name masked]'s laboratories. Partner cross-functionally with scientific subject matter experts. Leverage strong automation knowledge to contribute to the decision-making process to reach the best solutions. Collaborate on development of robust experiments that evaluate feasibility of a potential automated solutions, using data to guide direction. Work alongside scientists to learn or enhance laboratory skills related to ADC bioconjugation and protein purification to help deliver highly characterized molecules for discovery research. Execute and document early-stage experiments, feasibility studies and ultimately validation studies. Propose ideas, own responsibilities, and manage timelines effectively to meet milestones and deliver results. Leverage strong problem-solving skills to support all things laboratory automation. Communicate strongly with group leaders to ensure they are informed.

cond_0523.intro: We are looking for an Automation Engineer who will lead our automation core team within the Protein and Bioanalytical Sciences group. This person will be central to developing solutions that increase the efficiency, throughput, and cost effectiveness of processes conducted by the ADC Discovery and Cancer Immunology department, in support of the [Company name masked] Oncology research community. The Automation Engineer will collaborate with subject matter experts in ADC Conjugation and Protein Bioanalytical Sciences to analyze existing processes and tools with the goal of identifying high impact, automation focused improvements. These may include process, instrument, and software improvements. The resulting data driven recommendations will ensure that the proposed solutions have a meaningful positive effect on Key Productivity Indicators. The Automation Engineer will collaborate with scientists to execute and, at times, drive projects that fulfill the department's objectives. The goal is to enhance the research community's ability to quickly find targeted therapies to enable rapid advancement of cancer therapeutics.
cond_0523.responsibilities: Lead development of automated protocols on a variety of laboratory instruments. Development of assays on liquid handlers, such as [Product name masked], and [Product name masked]. Oversee automation efforts within the functional team; advise, plan and forecast how new automation strategies can enhance throughput and efficiency. Then help build the solutions. Take calculated risks and design automated solutions that are robust and easy to operate but provide [Company name masked] with a competitive edge. Leverage knowledge of programming languages like C+ and Python to enhance or expand the capabilities and flexibility of automated laboratory solutions. Keep your finger on the pulse of technology advances that can be leveraged to increase performance and robustness of [Company name masked]'s laboratories. Partner cross-functionally with scientific subject matter experts. Leverage strong automation knowledge to contribute to the decision-making process to reach the best solutions. Collaborate on development of robust experiments that evaluate feasibility of a potential automated solutions, using data to guide direction. Work alongside scientists to learn or enhance laboratory skills related to ADC bioconjugation and protein purification to help deliver highly characterized molecules for discovery research. Execute and document early-stage experiments, feasibility studies and ultimately validation studies. Propose ideas, own responsibilities, and manage timelines effectively to meet milestones and deliver results. Leverage strong problem-solving skills to support all things laboratory automation. Communicate strongly with group leaders to ensure they are informed.
cond_0523.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's Degree in Biochemistry, Engineering or related field, with 9+ years of experience, or Master's Degree with 7+ years of experience in a laboratory setting, including 3+ years developing laboratory automation of varying complexity.
Ability to program liquid handling robotics with strong knowledge of liquid class optimization.
Experience using programming languages to enhance the processing capabilities of automated platforms.
Ability to lead projects independently, with an understanding of when to seek guidance.
Strong troubleshooting and automation methodology capabilities.
Strong communication skills with ability to build cross-functional relationships and report progress to leadership.
Experience generating metrics and acting based on data.
Preferred Requirements
Prior experience with [Product name masked] liquid handlers, including end-to-end coding of new methods.
Experience writing plans, protocols, and reports for equipment qualification, experimental design, feasibility studies, and validation.
Experience performing bioconjugation and/or protein purification in an industry setting.
Experience with process mapping and Gantt charting.
Experience building customized parts for improved automation.
Experience with ELN integration.
Desire to assist colleagues with automation related issues.
